Help make SHOWS better.

Spot an incorrect listing, missing show or bug? Have an idea? Let me know.

SHOWS is a music-first calendar for Portland's independent scenes. The default list includes all approved upcoming events from our covered venues and sources, even when an event isn't music or its style is unknown. Categories help with browsing, not admission. Routine farmers markets and venue-closure notices are excluded; this is not a comprehensive city events feed. Coverage is evolving, and inclusion is not endorsement.

Dates and times reflect published organizer details and can change. Open the source listing to confirm before attending. Times use Portland's Pacific Time zone; unknown start or end times are identified in calendar exports. There are no accounts. Optional Google Analytics runs only if you allow it using Analytics preferences; saved events stay in this browser and are not sent through custom analytics events.
